COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
WPSS/1456/2026
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Harendra Belwal, Advocate for
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Vipul Sharma, Advocate for
the respondents.
3. Petitioner was engaged through
outsourcing in G.B. Pant University of
Agriculture and Technology to perform
duties of Generator Operator. The
outsourcing agency has transferred
the petitioner from Pantnagar to
Haridwar, vide order dated
30.04.2026. Thus, feeling aggrieved,
petitioner has approached this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that the token issued to the
petitioner by the outsourcing agency
has been cancelled without providing
any opportunity of hearing. It is
further contended that the order
impugned is stigmatic in nature.
5. Learned counsel appearing for
the University, however, submits that
petitioner's son Mr. Sahid Ansari is
creating problem in the University
campus, he is in the habit of
harassing girl students and he along
with other antisocial elements does
various nefarious activities within
University campus for which several
warnings were given to petitioner and

2026:UHC:4455
also his son. He points out that
written complaints were received
against petitioner's son by the parents
of girls students studying in the
University and the matter was also
reported to the police. He further
points out that petitioner's son was
barred from University campus by
Director (Administration), vide order
dated 14.12.2024 and he was
permanently barred from University
Campus, vide order dated
14.05.2026. Thus, he submits that
such antisocial activities by
petitioner's son cannot be tolerated.
He further submits that University has
not passed any order against the
petitioner and the impugned order, is
passed by the outsourcing agency,
and it is not a case of termination, but
that of transfer, as petitioner has been
transferred by the outsourcing agency
from Pantnagar to Haridwar.
6. Having regard to the serious
allegations against petitioner's son,
this Court is not inclined to interfere
in the matter. Even otherwise also, as
outsourced employee, petitioner does
not have any lien on any post in the
University.
7. The writ petition, accordingly,
fails and is dismissed.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 03.06.2026
